## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title is `<type>(<scope>): <description>`: English, printable ASCII, at most 70 characters, no trailing period. It becomes the squash commit title and a line in the release notes, so fix it here, not in the merge dialog.
- [ ] An incompatible change to the public API is marked with `!` after the scope (`feat(photosdb)!: ...`): it decides the next version.
- [ ] Tests were written first, and `make test lint` passes locally.
- [ ] Reference data (`testdata/golden`) was not edited by hand; it was regenerated by the workflow.
- [ ] User-visible changes are documented in Russian and English.
- [ ] Ported behavior is traceable: upstream file and lines in a comment, `// extension: not in osxphotos` for additions, `osxphotos/UPSTREAM.md` updated.
- [ ] A new dependency is justified in this description: why the standard library is not enough, and its license (MIT, BSD, Apache-2.0 or ISC).
- [ ] Changes to `.github/`, `scripts/`, `Makefile` or `go.mod` do not weaken any CI check.
- [ ] No personal data: no real album, folder or file names, paths, UUIDs, coordinates or logins in code, tests, fixtures or this description. Test databases are synthetic or come from upstream test libraries.
